meta.title: Hume Edge: Talk to Our Team About AI Adoption
meta.description: Ready to get your people AI-ready? Reach out and a member of the executive team will be in touch within 1–2 business days.

hero.titleHtml: Ready to get your people AI-ready? So are we.
hero.introHtml: Every engagement at Hume Edge starts the same way: a conversation about your organization, your people, and where your AI program stands right now. Fill out the form below, and a member of the executive team will be in touch within 1–2 business days.

expect.title: Your inquiry lands with a founding partner.
expect.body: Every message is reviewed personally, not by an intake team or an automated system.

expect.title: We review what you've shared.
expect.body: We look at where your organization is and what you're working through before we respond.

expect.title: You hear back within 1–2 business days.
expect.body: We'll reach out to schedule a focused conversation about your organization and how we can help.
